info.name: CollabSpace API v1
info.description:
REST API for CollabSpace (Laravel 13 + Sanctum).

1. Run **Auth → Login (demo admin)** — the token is saved automatically.
2. Create/select resources — ids are saved into collection variables.

Demo accounts (password `password`): admin@, lina@, omar@, sara@, ahmad@ collabspace.test

exec: if (pm.response.code < 300 && json && json.data.id !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('project_id', json.data.id);
